ai.title: MBZUAI’s IFM Releases PAN 2, an Open 29B World Model for Physical AI
ai.brief: The Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) at MBZUAI released PAN 2 , an open world model for physical intelligence. The PAN 2 world model takes a scene and a text action and simulates the outcome as video. IFM announced it on X on November 10, 2026. 0 . For robotics and agent developers, the pitch is simple: test a plan in simulation before acting on it. TL;DR Size: 29B-parameter diffusion transformer (MMDiT), dense. Inputs: text plus an optional first frame. Output: 704×1248 video at 24 fps, up to 20 s. Runs on: Data-center GPUs. Each worker holds the full 29B model in BF16, with block offloading as fallback. Performance: Leads 6 tested models on full plans. Trails MiniMax-H3 on single actions and human preference. 0% full-plan completion on 100 multi-step tasks, the highest of all models tested (self-reported). Worst: About 2 in 3 plans miss a step. 91 for MiniMax-H3.

sec.title: Hackers Advertise a $1,000 Gmail Tool That Allegedly Survives Password Resets
sec.brief: S. S. CISA adds SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog A developer of hacking tools is selling a $1,000 per month feature that allegedly gives criminals continuous access to Gmail inboxes. The cybersecurity firm Hudson Rock reports that the tool can keep reading a victim’s mailbox after a password change, after the browser closes and after sessions are revoked. ” reads the report published by cybersecurity firm Hudson Rock. ”
